name: Weave visible deterministic drafts
description: Verifies the core visual experiment produces a grid of inspectable artistic drafts from a prompt, seed, and chaos value.
steps: Keep the default prompt "storm ceramic insect jazz" and seed 4837291
Set Chaos to 72% and Drafts to 12
expected: Twelve visual draft cards are visible, each with a rendered canvas, draft number, render mode, and fingerprint.

name: Replay the same recipe
description: Verifies repeating the same recipe preserves the visible draft identities rather than silently rerolling them.
steps: Use prompt "glass insect cathedral", seed 4837291, chaos 72%, and six drafts
Press "Weave signals" and note the fingerprint shown on draft #01
Press "Weave signals" again without changing any control
expected: Draft #01 keeps the same fingerprint and visual composition after the second weave.

name: Inspect and capture a draft on mobile
description: Verifies a user can select an interesting accident and see the replay recipe on a narrow screen.
steps: Scroll to the Captured Signal inspector
expected: The inspector shows the selected draft number, render mode, seed, chaos, fingerprint, and JSON field data without hiding the result controls.

name: Change chaos and reroll
description: Verifies exploration controls visibly change the run while preserving the ability to identify the active seed.
steps: Observe the seed field, run metadata, and visual grid
expected: A new numeric seed is shown, the run metadata uses that seed, and the visual draft grid is regenerated.
